meta.title: Enumera't | Martí Sabaté
meta.description: Educational math adventure game in Catalan (prototype).

content.title: Enumera't
about: Enumera’t is an educational game in Catalan that turns basic math into an interactive adventure, aimed at kids aged 6–8.
Players explore a world of living numbers and solve quick arithmetic challenges through drag-and-drop interactions, repetition, and positive reinforcement.
features: Playful learning focus: math through gameplay and emotion (not rote exercises).
Story, characters, and references inspired by Catalan imagery and culture.
Core mechanic: drag numbers to complete operations with unknowns.
Adaptive difficulty and replayability with randomly generated operations.
Guided story missions plus an Infinite Mode for unlimited mental-math practice.
learnings: Designing drag-and-drop interactions that work well on both mouse and touch.
Generating arithmetic exercises procedurally to increase replayability.
Balancing feedback loops for learning (gentle failure, clear positive reinforcement).
